name: Tax SMA Trade Allocation Strategy
description: Onboard and formalize the Tax SMA trade allocation system into the workspace. Existing prototype: trade_allocator.py (1,632 lines) processes Axioma optimizer output through a constraint cascade (excluded securities, HTB validation, weight caps, sector bands, round lots, EMH balance) to produce Schwab upload CSVs for long/short SMA accounts. Three accounts active: Chiles (SMA 200, $1M), Nixon (SMA 200, $750K), Bump (SMA 145, $1.95M). Source data, outputs, and account manifest aggregated at models/tax_strategy/.
